entries.description: PolicyGuard integration test — stale cache -> Degraded -> ReduceOnly pipeline proof. Currently only unit-level opens_blocked() is tested; need full pipeline dispatch_count=0 proof from InstrumentCache staleness through PolicyGuard to dispatch rejection.
entries.mitigated_by: Unit-level tests prove mechanism. Pipeline test (test_at104_degraded_blocks_open_at_chokepoint) proves Degraded->rejection. Missing link is InstrumentCache->Degraded in production path.
entries.risk_if_unresolved: LOW — mechanism proven at both ends, just not end-to-end in one test

entries.description: Per-instrument TTL support — currently all instruments share a single global instrument_cache_ttl_s. CONTRACT.md does not require per-instrument TTL but it is a natural extension.
entries.mitigated_by: Global TTL satisfies contract requirements. Per-instrument is an enhancement.

entries.description: USDC API assumption remains unvalidated in live integration; current tests rely on static fixtures and parser behavior.
entries.mitigated_by: Strict deserialization and fixture-based tests cover expected schema shape.
entries.risk_if_unresolved: LOW — drift in live API payloads could bypass early detection until integration wiring is enabled

entries.description: Negative TTL input path lacks dedicated regression test; NaN/Inf coverage exists but explicit ttl_s < 0 proof is missing.
entries.mitigated_by: Current guard logic rejects invalid cache inputs and existing tests cover adjacent invalid domains.
entries.risk_if_unresolved: LOW — specific negative-value mutation may evade current tests

entries.description: Four bad-input `build_order_size` variants and METRIC_ORDER_SIZE_REJECT observability wiring remain incomplete.
entries.mitigated_by: Core sizing behavior and primary fail-closed paths are already covered by existing tests.

entries.description: PRD `reason_codes` metadata for S1-005 does not match actual dispatcher rejection variants.
entries.mitigated_by: Runtime rejection enums and tests remain correct; issue is traceability metadata only.

entries.description: Config loader wiring — 7 of 74 ConfigParam variants are wired to production consumers. Remaining params are declared with defaults and validation but not yet consumed. CI param count parity gate (EXPECTED_PARAM_COUNT) catches regressions.
entries.mitigated_by: Exhaustive iteration guard (EXPECTED_PARAM_COUNT) ensures new params cannot be added without updating the match. All defaults are fail-closed. Validation rejects NaN/Inf/negative.
entries.risk_if_unresolved: LOW — params have correct defaults and validation, just not consumed yet

entries.description: AT-040 Err path proof via SyntheticNoDefault — mechanism proven in unit test but structurally unreachable in production. All 74 ConfigParam variants have Appendix A defaults.
entries.mitigated_by: Exhaustive EXPECTED_PARAM_COUNT constant acts as compile-time-adjacent guard. SyntheticNoDefault test proves the mechanism.

entries.description: METRIC_EXPIRY_GUARD_REJECT is declared but not wired to runtime emission in expiry rejection paths.

entries.description: Deribit API field validation against live responses — DeribitInstrument struct is tested against static fixtures but not validated against live /public/get_instruments responses. Field names, types, and optional/required status may drift.
entries.mitigated_by: Struct uses serde(deny_unknown_fields) for strict deserialization. Static fixtures match documented API at time of implementation. Live validation requires API access.
entries.risk_if_unresolved: MEDIUM — API schema changes could cause silent field drops if new required fields are added

entries.description: Reconcile loop integration — classify_lifecycle_error() decision API is implemented and tested but not wired into production dispatch/reconcile path. DelistingSoon intermediate state not implemented. Buffer+reconcile interaction untested.
entries.mitigated_by: Decision logic is fully tested with table-driven tests covering all venue error categories. ExpiryGuard pre-dispatch blocking is functional. Post-dispatch lifecycle handling is the gap.
entries.risk_if_unresolved: MEDIUM — terminal venue errors are not handled in production; manual intervention required
